description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Financial Transaction Reporting Act, No. 6 of 2006
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of rules made by the Financial Intelligence Unit under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, No. 6 of 2006. It establishes regulatory requirements for designated non-finance businesses regarding customer due diligence, risk assessment, and anti-money laundering/terrorist financing measures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks for compliance.
